heading_en: Method of Calculating the Overall Net Position of the Foreign Exchange Risk Category
summary_ja: 外国為替リスク・カテゴリーの全体のネット・ポジションの額を、通貨ごとの合計、ロング・ショートの別の合計、およびそれらと金のネット・ポジションの合計により算出する手順を定める。
summary_en: Prescribes how to calculate the overall net position: totals by currency, separate long and short totals, and addition of the larger of the two to the gold net position.
paragraphs: The method of calculating the amount of the overall net position of the foreign exchange risk category shall be as prescribed in the following items: (i) For each currency, the following items shall be totaled (where it is recognized as unnecessary for risk management, the item set forth in (d) may be excluded); provided, however, that positions in gold shall be expressed in a standard unit of measurement (ounces) and converted into yen to calculate the amount of the net position, and for consolidated subsidiary juridical persons, etc. and branches, the limit on the foreign exchange position that may be held for internal management may be deemed to be the amount of the net position: (a) the amount of the net spot position (meaning the difference between assets and liabilities in each currency, including accrued interest receivable and accrued interest payable); (b) the amount of the net forward position (meaning the difference between future receipts and future payments under forward foreign exchange transactions, including the portion of the principal of currency swaps not included in the spot position); (c) the amount of guarantees (including similar transactions) that are certain to be called upon to be performed and for which there is no prospect of recovery even if reimbursement is claimed; (d) the amount of future receipts or payments that will arise, other than those falling under (b), and that have already been fully hedged; (e) other foreign exchange gains and losses; (ii) The amount of the net position for each currency calculated under the preceding item shall be separately totaled for long positions and short positions; (iii) The amounts set forth in (a) and (b) below shall be totaled to calculate the amount of the overall net position: (a) the larger of the total amount of long positions and the total amount of short positions in all currencies obtained under the preceding item; (b) the amount of the net position in gold.
